en: How do I contact the support team?
Where can I contact Tech Monster support?
How can I get help from support?
or: mu support ku kemiti contact karibi
support team ku kemiti contact karibi
Tech Monster support kouthi contact karibi
hi: main support se kaise contact karun
support team se kaise contact karun
Tech Monster support se kahan contact karun
mixed: mu support team ku kaise contact karibi
Tech Monster support kouthi contact karibi
main support ku kemiti contact karun

answers.en: You can contact the Tech Monster support team through the Help & Support section available in your dashboard.
answers.or: Tume dashboard re thiba Help & Support section madhyama re Tech Monster support team ku contact karipariba.
answers.hi: Aap apne dashboard mein available Help & Support section ke through Tech Monster support team se contact kar sakte hain.
answers.mixed: Dashboard re thiba Help & Support section madhyama re Tech Monster support team ku contact karipariba.

en: How long will I have to wait for support?
Is an admin available to answer my question?
or: support pain kete time wait karibaku padiba
mora question ra answer debaku admin available achhanti ki
hi: support ke liye kitna wait karna padega
kya mera question answer karne ke liye admin available hai
mixed: support pain kete time wait karibi

answers.en: If your question cannot be answered automatically, your request can be connected to the support team. Please wait for an admin response in the Help & Support conversation.
answers.or: Jadi tumara question automatically answer hei parunahi, tumara request support team saha connect hei pare. Help & Support conversation re admin response pain wait kara.
answers.hi: Agar aapke question ka automatic answer nahi milta hai, to aapki request support team se connect ki ja sakti hai. Help & Support conversation mein admin response ka wait karein.
answers.mixed: Jadi question automatically answer hei parunahi, request support team saha connect hei pare. Help & Support conversation re admin response pain wait kara.

en: The answer did not solve my problem
or: answer re mora problem solve hela nahi
mora issue ebe bhi solve heuni
hi: answer se meri problem solve nahi hui
mera issue abhi bhi solve nahi hua
mixed: answer re issue solve hela nahi
mera issue abhi bhi solve heuni

answers.en: I understand. This issue needs support from our team. Please wait while we connect you with the Tech Monster support team.
answers.or: Bujhili. Ehi issue pain amara support team ra help darkar. Dayakari wait kara, ame tumaku Tech Monster support team saha connect karuchhu.
answers.hi: Samajh gaya. Is issue ke liye hamari support team ki help chahiye. Kripya wait karein, hum aapko Tech Monster support team se connect kar rahe hain.
answers.mixed: Bujhili. Ehi issue pain support team ra help darkar. Please wait kara, ame tumaku Tech Monster support team saha connect karuchhu.

or: mote gote jinisha re help darkar
hi: mujhe kisi cheez mein help chahiye
kya koi meri help kar sakta hai

answers.en: Please describe your question or issue. I will check whether I can answer it automatically. If I cannot find a reliable answer, we will connect you with the support team.
answers.or: Dayakari tumara question ba issue describe kara. Mu check karibi je automatic bhabare reliable answer deiparibi ki nahi. Jadi reliable answer milila nahi, ame tumaku support team saha connect karibu.
answers.hi: Kripya apna question ya issue batayein. Main check karunga ki iska reliable automatic answer diya ja sakta hai ya nahi. Agar reliable answer nahi mila, to hum aapko support team se connect karenge.
answers.mixed: Tumara question ba issue describe kara. Mu check karibi reliable automatic answer miluchi ki nahi. Jadi answer na milila, ame support team saha connect karibu.
